from.place: The category of discrete G-modules with continuous action used in the injective-embedding assertion

title: Category of discrete modules with continuous action
statement: For a topological group $G$ and a ring $A$, $\operatorname{Mod}^{\mathrm{disc}}(A,G)$ is the category whose objects are left $A$-modules with a $G$-action by $A$-linear automorphisms in which every element has an open stabilizer, and whose morphisms are the $A$-linear $G$-equivariant maps.
